HexapodSAR

A six-legged search-and-rescue robot that climbs over collapsed-building rubble and streams live thermal vision, gas readings and a LiDAR map to the team outside — so no rescuer has to crawl into an unstable void to find out who is still alive.

Live simulation · the thermal and LiDAR feeds are rendered in real time from the robot’s own sensor positions, so they turn when it turns.
